_comment: PFD v2.3 Configuration Reference — All configurable options with defaults and descriptions
_usage: Add 'config' object to your spec.json to customize. All fields optional—omit to use defaults.

containerWidth.description: Diagram container width in pixels. Set to 1600 for fixed-width (horizontal scroll on narrow), null or 1920 for responsive (scales to max 1920px).

edgeLabelSpacing.description: Vertical distance of payload labels above connector lines.

opacity.description: Background plate opacity for payload labels. 0 = transparent, 1 = fully solid.

fill.description: Background plate fill color for payload labels (the pill drawn behind edge/branch/loop text so the connector line doesn't strike through the glyphs).

overlayMode.description: true = position:fixed overlay, false = layout push (deprecated)

showIOTable.description: Show Input → Output table on page (true) or hide for drawer-only (false)
